$comment: #EXP-2172 (epic #EXP-2169; the approved CI redesign of session 64abb994, Danny 2026-11-27): THE CI PAGE x4 (view `ci`: web /ci, the desktop's CI screen, iOS and Android's CI destination; the phones' More menu entry), ONE ROOT row after Devices (sidebar-tree.json), across every member team. DATA, all synced: `ci_runs` + `ci_jobs` (our runs AND GitHub Actions runs, `provider` exponential | github; `title` = what the run is about: the head commit's first line, the PR's title, GitHub's display_title), `pull_requests`, the sessions shape (a root's starter), the users shape (a run's author = `createdByUserId`), repository full names, the devices shape (rows whose `runner.enabled` is true = the runners). `utcOffsetMinutes` = the viewer's clock offset (the day sections). STATUS TONES (`statusTones`, THE one table, also the run page's): passed ci-passed success, failed ci-failed danger, running ci-running INFO (blue, the only moving mark), queued ci-queued neutral, cancelled / skipped ci-skipped neutral (muted text, never struck through). A run's status = ci-run.json `runStatus` over its jobs; source = `github` for provider github, else `exponential`; `mine` = the viewer started it or its PR's root session is the viewer's. RUNS (`ciRunList`, `ciRunGroups`): newest first by startedAt (else createdAt), ties by id, at most `limits.runs`, filtered by status All | Running (running + queued) | Failed | Mine, a repository (`ciRepoOptions`) and a source. A ROW (`ciRunRow`): title = the run's `title`, else a pending merge train run's batch (copy.batchTitle over the repo's testing PRs' numbers), else its PR's title, else the pipeline's name; workflow = `name #n`; repo = the full name's last segment (copy.unknownRepository while unknown); subtitle (wide) = workflow · repo · ref · sha7 · trigger (copy.pullRequest with the PR's number for a pull request run whose PR is known, else copy.triggers[trigger], unknown = raw); phoneSubtitle = repo · ref · workflow; duration = pr-checks formatDuration of (completedAt or now) - startedAt, null before it started; phoneMeta = the duration, else copy.queued; wide trailing = `duration · age` (else `copy.waitingForRunner · age`; the age = the catalog's formatRelativeTime of `at`), the source mark, the author's avatar; `at` = startedAt else createdAt (the age, drawn relative); sourceIcon github | brand-exponential (its tooltip = sourceLabel); author = the users row of createdByUserId (an avatar), null when none. SECTIONS (`ciRunGroups`): In progress (copy.inProgress with the count: running + queued) first, then one per LOCAL day of `at` (`ciDayTitle`: copy.today, copy.yesterday, else `d Mon` from copy.months, + ` yyyy` when not this year). A running merge train run sits in In progress; the train's detail is the Merge train tab. RUNNER CHIP (`ciRunnerChip`): copy.runnerChip over runners online (lastSeenAt younger than `limits.runnerOnlineMs`) of all, a green dot while one is online; none without runners; a press opens the Runners tab. THE BADGE (nav-badges.json destination `ci`, `ciBadge`): the viewer's runs, the NEWEST per (repository, pipeline name, ref): failed ones = that count, `attention` (a green re-run clears it); else the running or queued ones, `muted`; else none. MERGE TRAIN TAB (`ciTrainGroups(input, true)`): per repository (by name; caption = the PRs' base) its testing batches (one row each: the first member's `#n`, the PR's title alone or copy.train.batch with {count}, the members `#n title` joined by ` · `, glyph ci-running, badge merge-train.json copy.pill.testing), the queued PRs by mergePosition (copy.pill.queuedAt with its `ordinal`, glyph ci-queued), then the waiting ones by number (copy.pill checksRunning | onHold | conflict | failing; glyph ci-queued for checks, ci-skipped for held, else ci-failed); a row opens its PR. RUNNERS TAB (`ciRunnerRows`): online first, then by name; subtitle = runner-settings.json `runnerOsLabel` then its own labels lower-cased (copy.runners.noLabels when none); busy = copy.runners.busy (online only); queue = copy.runners.queue over OUR queued, undispatched jobs whose runsOn it covers (null when none); offlineSince = its lastSeenAt while offline (the catalog's `fill` of copy.runners.offlineSince with `formatRelativeTime`). No lanes. TAB COUNTS (`ciTabCounts`): Merge train = its rows, Runners = the runners. LAYOUT node for node: ci-page-view.json (reference apps/web/src/lib/ci-page-view.ts). Replayed by packages/domain-contract (bun test), desktop domain::ci_page, iOS ExpCore CiPage, Android domain/CiPage.kt over every case, comparing the WHOLE result. #EXP-2169 ("one look"): copy.filters.all reads `All runs` (the status picker's own label now that it is a `Select{button}`, ci-page-view.json) and copy.filterLabels names the three pickers (accessible names). #EXP-2214 (Danny 2026-11-28, "the ci page makes no sense"; plan card in session 3d1f8107): THIS SUPERSEDES the Runs tab and the Merge train tab above. FOUR TABS, one meaning each (`CI_TABS` order, the platform's segmented control; labels copy.tabs, phones copy.phoneTabs; counts `ciTabCounts`: the merge queue's PRs testing + up next, the Open pull requests, the release runs in progress, the runners; 0 = none): MERGE QUEUE (opens first) · PULL REQUESTS · RELEASES · RUNNERS. "Merge train" is called MERGE QUEUE in every UI string (copy.triggers.merge_train, the tab, the kind badge); code, tables and branches keep `merge_train` / `exp-train/`. RUN KIND (`ciRunKind`, `kindCases`): train = trigger merge_train, a merge_train_id, or an `exp-train/` ref; pull_request = a PR or the pull_request trigger; release = tag, manual, schedule, or a push to the repository's default branch (`defaultBranch`, the synced repositories row's override else its default; unknown = `main`); else branch. DATA added: `ci_runs.merge_train_id`, the synced `merge_trains` (shape merge-trains: no heads, run_ref, conflicts, error) and `merge_train_events` (shape merge-train-events: the worker's landed | failing | conflict | held | merge_now | resumed rows, with the red checks and their job (`ci_job_id`, else the forge's `job_url`), the conflict files, the landed sha), the repositories shape (`defaultBranch`), PRs' state, merge_wait, merge_hold, merge_now, merge_attempts, jobs' id and check. MERGE QUEUE TAB (`ciQueue`, `queueCases`; its doc comment is the rule): per repository with anything live or any history in `limits.historyHours`: the stats (wide), one Testing now card per live train (what is tested on which base commit, its members, the progress against `ciTypicalTrainMs` = the median of the repo's last finished green queue runs, `ciTrainEta`, `etaCases`), Up next (by position, Merge now first, a ⋯ Menu: Merge now, Hold), Not ready yet (folded past 5; Resume on a PR held by the limits), Sent back (the failing and conflict events, Open log to the red job), Landed. PULL REQUESTS TAB (`ciPrGroups`, `prGroupsCases`): one row per PR (branch runs per ref under Branches), its rolled-up status, the deciding run's line, wide its merge pill (`ciMergePill`), its runs folded under it; Open, Branches, Merged or closed (folded); filters status and repository (the source picker is gone). RELEASES TAB: `ciRunGroups(input, filter, ['release'])` (`releaseGroupsCases`): In progress then the days; a tag run's title is its tag. THE RUN PAGE (`ciRunContext`, `runContextCases`; ci-run-view.json `context`): a kind Badge first in the chip strip (copy.kinds, a PR run `Pull request #n`), a merge queue run titled by its batch (copy.batchTitle, one PR copy.batchOne) with a What happened Section (caption `main @ sha`): each PR of its train landed / sent back (Open log selects the red job when it is this run's) / being tested / back in the queue. THE REPO PAGE'S RUNS TAB: the first three tabs as a `Segmented` inside the tree, limited to the repository (ci-page-view.json `repositoryId` cases with a `tab`). Regenerate the cases with `bun packages/domain-contract/scripts/bless-ci-page.ts` (the scenario is authored here).
